prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A futuristic, high-gloss corridor bathed in iridescent pastel hues, with prismatic reflections shimmering across the mirrored walls and floor. Two young women stand confidently in the center, striking dynamic dance poses. The woman on the left wears an all-white ensemble: a tailored blazer, high-waisted pants, and a cropped top, exuding a sleek, modern vibe. The woman on the right contrasts in an all-black outfit—an oversized blazer, wide-leg trousers, and a matching crop top—her stance bold and expressive. Both have straight, dark hair styled simply, and their expressions are focused and self-assured. The lighting is bright and ethereal, emanating from a glowing white portal at the end of the corridor, creating a sense of depth and infinity. The overall composition is symmetrical and cinematic, with a wide-angle lens capturing the reflective surfaces and the dancers’ poised energy, evoking a high-fashion, music video aesthetic with a touch of sci-fi surrealism.
